I agree to 12 tons this month if all five explicitly agree, and 6 each next month if the stock starts at 80. Otherwise, I’ll choose 10 unless we unanimously agree on another whole-ton allocation.

Kate’s long-run comparison makes this worth trying. Let’s check the stock before each month’s decisions and review the catch reports together. If someone exceeds the agreement, we should address it directly rather than respond with catches that risk collapsing everyone’s income.

Jack, you’re the last person we haven’t heard from—are you willing to join on those terms?
